hooks.name: TypeScript quality gate
hooks.description: After the agent saves any TypeScript file (desktop app, backend, contracts, tests, scripts, or build config; all are typechecked), run the fast harness and fix only errors the edit caused.

action.prompt: A TypeScript file was just saved. Run `npm run verify:fast`. If it fails, fix only errors caused by the files changed in this session, then run it again. Report the exact commands and their results, and do not claim a check passed unless you ran it.
